paperclip.usage: Direct full-text virtual-filesystem reads with line-pinned citations; no repository clone.

sources.title: Further Improvements to the Lower Bound for an Autoconvolution Inequality
sources.used_claim: The reported C2 construction is a high-resolution spike-plus-comb profile and the optimization compares direct full-resolution with coarse-to-fine/global peak-flattening strategies.

sources.title: The second autocorrelation inequality: towards a constructive proof that C >= 0.901564
sources.used_claim: The construction uses simulated annealing and a 23-to-115-to-575 multiscale optimization hierarchy.

sources.title: ImprovEvolve: Basin-Hopping Meets LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
sources.used_claim: The work frames mathematical optimization around evolved initialization, improvement, and perturbation operators with intensity-scheduled basin hopping; this supported testing a bounded global operator rather than local float polish.

exa.usage: Primary-publication discovery and highlighted full-text inspection; credential was read from the configured Keychain and was not copied into artifacts.

requests.purpose: Find primary measure-optimization methods that change global support topology.
Inspect the primary Sliding Frank-Wolfe paper and its support-insertion/joint-relocation mechanism.

sources.title: The Sliding Frank-Wolfe Algorithm and its Application to Super-Resolution Microscopy
sources.used_claim: The algorithm alternates certificate-guided support insertion with joint amplitude and position optimization.
sources.scope_limit: Its finite-convergence theory concerns a convex sparse inverse problem under nondegeneracy; it is not a convergence theorem for the nonconvex C2 max-ratio objective. Only the operator pattern was borrowed as a heuristic.

sources.title: Sparse Inverse Problems Over Measures: Equivalence of the Conditional Gradient and Exchange Methods
sources.used_claim: Exchange and conditional-gradient methods provide a primary-source vocabulary for finite support insertion and re-optimization over measures.
sources.scope_limit: The equivalence does not transfer a guarantee to this C2 search; it only motivated a global support-changing probe.

methodological_conclusion: Primary literature supports multiscale continuation and explicit support-changing operators as plausible global mechanisms. This run tested a finite coordinated bundle-crossover analogue and found a negative frontier; it does not claim that the source algorithms themselves fail on C2.
